scope: exposed development replay plus independently rendered controlled mechanism; no deployment or cross-scene claim
goal: preserve valid geometry and repair errors by improving observation ownership
primary_claim: A center-connected reference support combined with a common plane warp reduces wrong-surface decisions without sacrificing the large repairs, under the fixed candidate pool and simple P selector.
secondary_claim: Observed matching support localization can be linked to candidate quality under explicit ownership, warp-error and texture-separation assumptions; those assumptions are challenged by controlled counterexamples.
selection: frozen historical P: nearest frozen candidate to length-uniform mean of depth support; keep current output if no positive point gain or empty; no new candidates
fixed_population: 21 active requests, 105 candidates and 18 historical incumbents; 512 full requests; 484 original-CPU-valid primary; four ROI in scans118/122
sources: historical REQUESTS.json: reference0022, sources0017/0061; same public wide bounds and 1mm grid
score: grayscale masked NCC, threshold0.6, minimum std3 on 0..255 intensities, minimum9 mask pixels, bilinear sampling

masks.connected9: reference-only center4connected component, adjacent absolute gray difference <=20; no target-dependent mask and no depth/GT input

warp.plane: each selected reference ray intersects common frontoparallel optical-Z plane; project intersections into source camera

support: all depths passing both sources at the same z; connected grid runs expanded by halfstep+1mm, clipped to domain. These filled cells are engineering approximation, not a continuous physical coverage certificate.
legacy_support: independently padded per-view full9 translation components intersected; exact replay bridge to historical star_full_P
success: primary arm has lower four-ROI-equal NN MSE than frozen legacy_full9 and fewer <=1mm to >1mm harms; retain both historical upper_fold large-repair choices. All arms reported irrespective of success.
execution: CPU only. Lock protocol and main sources before raw extraction. Seal observations before candidate access; seal decisions before evaluation. No tuning on real results.
calibration: no claim that fixed NCC cutoff has equal false-match probability across mask sizes
